access_grants_scope.name: access_grants_scope
access_grants_scope.value: CASE WHEN "bricx"."access_grants"."permission" LIKE '%.site' THEN "bricx"."access_grants"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bricx"."access_grants"."site_id" IS NOT NULL WHEN "bricx"."access_grants"."permission" LIKE '%.project' THEN "bricx"."access_grants"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bricx"."access_grants"."site_id" IS NULL ELSE "bricx"."access_grants"."scope_id" IS NULL AND "bricx"."access_grants"."site_id" IS NULL END

access_grants_window.name: access_grants_window
access_grants_window.value: "bricx"."access_grants"."starts_at" < "bricx"."access_grants"."expires_at" AND "bricx"."access_grants"."expires_at" - "bricx"."access_grants"."starts_at" BETWEEN interval '60 seconds' AND interval '30 days'

audit_events_actor.name: audit_events_actor
audit_events_actor.value: "bricx"."audit_events"."actor_type" IN ('user', 'system') AND ("bricx"."audit_events"."actor_type" <> 'user' OR "bricx"."audit_events"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL)

audit_events_ip_host.name: audit_events_ip_host
audit_events_ip_host.value: masklen("bricx"."audit_events"."ip") = CASE family("bricx"."audit_events"."ip") WHEN 4 THEN 32 ELSE 128 END

outbox_published_or_dead.name: outbox_published_or_dead
outbox_published_or_dead.value: NOT ("bricx"."outbox"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bricx"."outbox"."dead_at" IS NOT NULL)

project_memberships_overrides.name: project_memberships_overrides
project_memberships_overrides.value: jsonb_typeof("bricx"."project_memberships"."overrides") = 'object' AND octet_length("bricx"."project_memberships"."overrides"::text) <= 4096 AND ("bricx"."project_memberships"."overrides" - 'add' - 'remove') = '{}'::jsonb AND (NOT "bricx"."project_memberships"."overrides" ? 'add' OR jsonb_typeof("bricx"."project_memberships"."overrides" -> 'add') = 'array') AND (NOT "bricx"."project_memberships"."overrides" ? 'remove' OR jsonb_typeof("bricx"."project_memberships"."overrides" -> 'remove') = 'array')

projects_contract_value.name: projects_contract_value
projects_contract_value.value: ("bricx"."projects"."contract_value_minor" IS NULL) = ("bricx"."projects"."contract_value_currency" IS NULL) AND "bricx"."projects"."contract_value_minor" >= 0 AND "bricx"."projects"."contract_value_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'

region_configs_org_columns.name: region_configs_org_columns
region_configs_org_columns.value: "bricx"."region_configs"."project_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("bricx"."region_configs"."currency" IS NULL AND "bricx"."region_configs"."language" IS NULL AND "bricx"."region_configs"."timezone" IS NULL AND "bricx"."region_configs"."units" IS NULL)

region_configs_project_fields.name: region_configs_project_fields
region_configs_project_fields.value: "bricx"."region_configs"."project_id" IS NULL OR ("bricx"."region_configs"."currency" IS NULL AND "bricx"."region_configs"."reporting_currency" IS NULL AND "bricx"."region_configs"."timezone" IS NULL)

region_configs_payment_adapters.name: region_configs_payment_adapters
region_configs_payment_adapters.value: cardinality("bricx"."region_configs"."payment_adapters") <= 16 AND (cardinality("bricx"."region_configs"."payment_adapters") = 0 OR array_ndims("bricx"."region_configs"."payment_adapters") = 1) AND array_position("bricx"."region_configs"."payment_adapters", NULL) IS NULL AND array_to_string("bricx"."region_configs"."payment_adapters", ',') ~ '^([a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,62}(,[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,62})*)?$'
